units.quote: Invented public-display permit policy. This is a diagnostic document, not legal guidance.
units.meaning: This text provides background framing and metadata indicating that the document is an invented policy diagnostic document and not legal guidance, containing no substantive regulatory duties, prohibitions, permissions, or conditions to retain.

units.quote: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:
units.meaning: For any temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer is required to satisfy all four of the listed conditions (illuminating exits, keeping exits clear, appointing an adult steward, and providing an inspection record).

units.quote: The organizer must illuminate every public exit throughout the time the display remains open.
scope_quotes: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:
units.meaning: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer is required to illuminate every public exit continuously throughout the entire time the display remains open.

units.quote: The organizer must keep every public exit clear throughout the time the display remains open.
scope_quotes: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:
units.meaning: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer is required to keep every public exit clear continuously throughout the entire time the display remains open.

units.quote: Equipment stored behind a locked staff-only door is not an obstruction of a public exit.
scope_quotes: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:
The organizer must keep every public exit clear throughout the time the display remains open.
units.meaning: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises where exits must be kept clear, equipment stored behind a locked staff-only door is expressly excepted from being deemed an obstruction of a public exit.

units.quote: The organizer must appoint an adult steward who remains on site throughout the time the display remains open.
scope_quotes: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:
units.meaning: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer is required to appoint an adult steward who must remain on site throughout the entire duration that the display remains open.

units.quote: This appointment duty does not apply when an agency employee is assigned to supervise the display for that entire period.
scope_quotes: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:
The organizer must appoint an adult steward who remains on site throughout the time the display remains open.
units.meaning: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer is exempt from the requirement to appoint an adult steward when an agency employee is assigned to supervise the display for that entire period.

units.quote: Before admitting the first visitor, the organizer must give the agency either a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer.
scope_quotes: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:
units.meaning: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, prior to admitting the first visitor, the organizer is required to provide the agency with an inspection record in one of two permissible formats: a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer.

units.quote: Before admitting the first visitor
scope_quotes: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:
units.meaning: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the inspection record must be provided to the agency prior to the admission of the first visitor.

units.quote: a signed paper inspection record
scope_quotes: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:
Before admitting the first visitor, the organizer must give the agency either a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer.
units.meaning: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, as one alternative under the parent requirement to give the agency either a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer, the organizer may submit a signed paper inspection record.

units.quote: an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer
scope_quotes: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:
Before admitting the first visitor, the organizer must give the agency either a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer.
units.meaning: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, as one alternative under the parent requirement to give the agency either a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer, the organizer may submit an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer.

units.quote: Each record must identify the display, the inspection date, and every public exit inspected.
scope_quotes: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:
units.meaning: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, each inspection record submitted to the agency must identify the display, the date of the inspection, and every public exit that was inspected.

units.quote: When a storm warning is active, the organizer must suspend outdoor demonstrations unless all of the following conditions are met:
units.meaning: During any active storm warning, the organizer is required to suspend outdoor demonstrations unless all three specified conditions (fixed roof, measured wind speed below 20 km/h, and officer authorization) are concurrently met.

units.quote: The demonstration takes place beneath a fixed roof.
scope_quotes: When a storm warning is active, the organizer must suspend outdoor demonstrations unless all of the following conditions are met:
units.meaning: During an active storm warning, in order to avoid the mandatory suspension of outdoor demonstrations under the parent rule, the demonstration must take place beneath a fixed roof.

units.quote: The agency has measured wind speed below 20 kilometers per hour at the demonstration site within the preceding 10 minutes.
scope_quotes: When a storm warning is active, the organizer must suspend outdoor demonstrations unless all of the following conditions are met:
units.meaning: During an active storm warning, in order to avoid the mandatory suspension of outdoor demonstrations under the parent rule, the agency must have measured the wind speed at the demonstration site to be below 20 kilometers per hour within the preceding 10 minutes.

units.quote: below 20 kilometers per hour at the demonstration site within the preceding 10 minutes
scope_quotes: When a storm warning is active, the organizer must suspend outdoor demonstrations unless all of the following conditions are met:
units.meaning: Under the storm warning exception, the wind speed measured by the agency at the demonstration site must meet a threshold of strictly less than 20 kilometers per hour, measured within a recency threshold of the preceding 10 minutes.

units.quote: An agency officer authorizes the demonstration for the duration of the current warning.
scope_quotes: When a storm warning is active, the organizer must suspend outdoor demonstrations unless all of the following conditions are met:
units.meaning: During an active storm warning, in order to avoid the mandatory suspension of outdoor demonstrations under the parent rule, an agency officer must authorize the demonstration for the duration of that current warning.

units.quote: The authorization expires when that warning ends
scope_quotes: When a storm warning is active, the organizer must suspend outdoor demonstrations unless all of the following conditions are met:
An agency officer authorizes the demonstration for the duration of the current warning.
units.meaning: An agency officer's authorization permitting an outdoor demonstration during a storm warning expires automatically when that specific warning ends.

units.quote: it does not authorize demonstrations under a later warning.
scope_quotes: When a storm warning is active, the organizer must suspend outdoor demonstrations unless all of the following conditions are met:
An agency officer authorizes the demonstration for the duration of the current warning.
units.meaning: An authorization issued for an outdoor demonstration during one storm warning does not permit or authorize demonstrations under any subsequent or later warning.

units.quote: For displays held entirely before sunset, the organizer should place a readable map near the entrance.
units.meaning: For displays held entirely before sunset, the organizer is advised and recommended (should) to place a readable map near the entrance.

units.quote: This recommendation does not create a duty to illuminate exits after sunset.
scope_quotes: For displays held entirely before sunset, the organizer should place a readable map near the entrance.
units.meaning: The recommendation to place a readable map near the entrance for daytime displays held entirely before sunset does not impose or establish a duty to illuminate exits after sunset.

units.quote: The organizer must retain each inspection record for at least 30 calendar days after the display closes.
units.meaning: The organizer is required to retain each inspection record for a minimum threshold of at least 30 calendar days following the closure of the display.

units.quote: at least 30 calendar days after the display closes
scope_quotes: The organizer must retain each inspection record for at least 30 calendar days after the display closes.
units.meaning: The minimum retention duration threshold for each inspection record is 30 calendar days following the closure of the display.

units.quote: Weekends and holidays count toward the 30 days.
scope_quotes: The organizer must retain each inspection record for at least 30 calendar days after the display closes.
units.meaning: In calculating the 30-calendar-day retention period for inspection records, weekends and holidays are expressly included and counted toward the 30 days.

units.quote: If an investigation is open when that period ends, the organizer must retain the record until the agency closes the investigation.
scope_quotes: The organizer must retain each inspection record for at least 30 calendar days after the display closes.
units.meaning: If an agency investigation remains open at the conclusion of the initial 30-calendar-day retention period, the organizer must continue to retain the inspection record until the agency officially closes the investigation.

units.quote: Visitors are not required to supply their home addresses.
units.meaning: Visitors are under no obligation and are exempt from any requirement to provide or supply their home addresses.

units.quote: This policy does not prohibit visitors from bringing paper maps
units.meaning: Visitors are permitted under this policy to bring paper maps, as the policy contains no prohibition against them.

units.quote: other premises rules may restrict particular materials.
scope_quotes: This policy does not prohibit visitors from bringing paper maps, but other premises rules may restrict particular materials.
units.meaning: Although this policy does not prohibit paper maps, rules established elsewhere for the premises may independently restrict particular materials.

units.quote: A queue may form when several groups arrive together.
units.meaning: This text is a descriptive background observation regarding visitor arrival behavior (stating that a queue may form when several groups arrive together) and contains no substantive regulatory duties, permissions, prohibitions, recommendations, conditions, or rules to retain.
